title: Robotics reliability vs restaurant leadership
operator_notes: Check whether the system chooses one lane cleanly instead of splitting the difference.
raw_notes: I keep circling between two things. One is robotics where I stopped chasing speed and started building checklists after our test runs kept failing. The other is helping at my family's restaurant where I started training younger cousins because I realized me doing everything fast was creating more confusion. Both feel true and I do not know which one is stronger for my essay yet.

raw_notes: I volunteer at a clinic and sometimes translate for families, but the part that stays with me is when I realized nodding did not mean understanding. After that I stopped explaining things the fast way and started checking what people actually meant back to me. I have some rough lines written already but they sound too generic right now.
